messages.content: Input candidate_clusters contains read-only ClusterContext objects: reference_id, prior_hypothesis, prior_assessment. These are unverified historical claims, never output templates. Output clusters contains only ClusterProposal objects: cluster_id, hypothesis, assessment, links. To revise a context use its reference_id as cluster_id; otherwise use NEW. Never output verified, gate_passed, execution_authorized, context fields, or host status, even false. Only host verification and Gate state machines maintain VerifiedCluster status. A proposal confers no permissions. Each cluster has at most ONE link per evidence_id. Each link has evidence_id, relation (SUPPORTS/CONTRADICTS/UNRELATED/UNCERTAIN), reason, quote_spans (1..8 exact public substrings), new_information (boolean). Multiple quotes from one event belong to the same quote_spans array, not repeated links. Choose one aggregate relation; when quotes conflict or cannot establish a single direction, use UNCERTAIN and explain the conflict. Never delete conflicting quotes merely to obtain acceptance. Relations remain unverified hypotheses. Describe the supplied historical public evidence, separating observations from uncertain causes and proposed corrections. Do not equate a subject label or wrong answer with a common mechanism. Retrieve candidate relationships using task structure, reasoning, observed symptoms and possible corrections. A record may belong to multiple hypotheses or none. State UNKNOWN when unsupported. Candidate clusters and their claims are UNVERIFIED. Host text omissions are not model truncation; finish_reason describes actual delivery. Do not infer correctness from absent feedback. No fixed algorithm, mechanism name, number, success or root cause is required. Do not invent quotes. Do not certify truth or permissions. Return JSON with exactly the example keys; clusters may be empty; descriptions must cover all supplied evidence. Relation must follow evidence-link-v2. Make TWO independent assessments. mechanism_assessment judges evidence for a shared failure cause; SUPPORTED is only your evidence assessment, never host verification. algorithm_candidate judges whether there is a specific parameterized deterministic computation worth IMPLEMENTING AND TESTING. SUSPECTED or UNSUPPORTED cause does not prohibit GENERATE. A plausible common cause does not imply an executable algorithm. GENERATE requires a closed parameter JSON schema, explicit output role/quantity, concrete computational steps with inputs/outputs, premises, rejection conditions, finite resource bounds and an independently checkable validation plan. Advice such as check carefully, find a construction or prove optimality without an implementable procedure must be NEEDS_SPECIFICATION or NOT_GENERATABLE. You may propose a bounded verifier without solving the full problem; use DIAGNOSTIC, not ANSWER. A diagnostic is not a replacement answer solver. Do not assume or assert oracle availability, validated correctness, admission or common causality. Proposed tests or expected answers are not trusted oracles. No algorithm name, count, success or predefined mathematical implementation is required. Do not use gold, future tasks, fixed answers or task-ID lookup. Host clipping is not model truncation. Each cluster assessment must conform to this schema:
